description: This Java class 'LoanApplicationTransitionValidator' handles validation logic for loan application state transitions, including approval, rejection, and applicant withdrawal, within the Fineract project. It checks JSON input, validates loan status transitions, and ensures client/group activity status.

classes.name: LoanApplicationTransitionValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating loan application state transitions such as approval, rejection, and withdrawal, ensuring proper status and client/group activity states.

methods.name: validateApproval
methods.description: Validates the approval request JSON for required fields and correct data types, ensuring positive amounts and valid dates.

methods.name: validateRejection
methods.description: Validates the loan rejection request, including date and note, and checks loan status transition.

methods.name: validateLoanRejection
methods.description: Performs detailed validation for loan rejection, including client/group activity, account status, and state transition rules.

methods.name: validateApplicantWithdrawal
methods.description: Validates the withdrawal request JSON and processes the withdrawal validation logic.

methods.name: validateLoanApplicantWithdrawal
methods.description: Performs detailed validation for loan withdrawal, including date checks and state transition validation.

methods.name: validateActivityNotBeforeClientOrGroupTransferDate
methods.description: Ensures activity date is not before client's transfer date to the office.

methods.name: validateAccountStatus
methods.description: Checks if the loan account is in a valid state for the attempted transition.

methods.name: checkClientOrGroupActive
methods.description: Verifies that the associated client or group is active before proceeding with state transitions.
